title: Dollar carry (Lustig, Roussanov and Verdelhan 2014): time the basket of foreign currencies vs USD by the average forward discount
signal: AFD = mean over 6E/6J/6B/6A/6C/6S of log(near/far) / roll spacing (annualised forward discount from the futures curve; > 0 means foreign rates above US rates); 21-day mean at month end
rule: next month long all six currency futures (0.10 / vol / 6 each) when AFD > 0, short all when AFD < 0; daily_book costs
selection: single setting; enters only if 2010-06..2022-12 Sharpe > 0.3
judgement: EQR book + entrant; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.231
